sources.title: This board's pinned two-divisor compression census good-compress2-v1 (pc2_inst.c, pc2_join.c), run to completion at n=75 with compression by 5 and by 3

notes: No published search at this order was found in a literature check on 2026-11-25. The full two-divisor compression census run on this board (1,612,793 instances of length 15 after compression by 5 and the multiplier reduction, in 3,137 signature groups, every one lifted through the compression by 3 in 79 units; 0 quadruples) finds no good matrices of order 75. This is a single run of one engine; the count is exact on the board only through the registered replay of the pinned engine.
